reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (implementing agent, self-review; not a cold reviewer)
method: Self-review by the agent that wrote the change, on a local dev server reading production (read-only). Home and the Millikin album report were captured at 1440x900 and 375x812: live (production has no launch snapshot yet, so nothing shows), and with findings replayed from production history as of Oct 6, mounted on the real page components through a throwaway harness route deleted before this receipt. Home was captured with a fresh check (12 minutes) and a late one (3 hours); the owner view was captured with the dismiss form open on Home and the snooze form open on the album report. The harness forces the owner flag; it proves how the real components render, not that the scheduler writes these snapshots or that a signed-in dismiss round-trips through the endpoint. Checked: no sideways scroll and no content cut off at the right edge (gate forced to fail once earlier), Tab reaches every finding control and the owner's Dismiss with a 3px focus ring, Enter opens the evidence disclosure and the dismiss form with focus in the reason box, every finding control is at least 44px tall, no collection or non-GET request during the walk. Not covered: a real signed-in session (sign-in, submit, undo against the database), largest text and increased contrast, and a cold review.
scope: Home launch findings under launch cards with last-checked line
Album report findings above the photo grid
